lessons.title: Bernardi Reversible & Irreversible Heat Generation Modeling
lessons.summary: Derive total heat flux Q_dot = I(V_ocv - V) - I*T*(dVocv/dT) separating entropic reversible cooling/heating from Joule resistance dissipation.
inputs: Entropic coefficient dU/dT lookup curve vs SOC
checkpoints: Observe entropic cooling during early charge phase
Validate total heat generation against calorimeter lab data

lessons.title: 1D Lumped-Capacitance vs. Multi-Node Thermal Networks
lessons.summary: Evaluate Biot number criteria (Bi < 0.1) and quantify core-to-surface thermal lag in large-format prismatic and pouch cells.
checkpoints: Calculate Biot number Bi = 0.38 requiring 2-node model
Plot core vs skin temperature divergence at 4C continuous

lessons.title: Liquid Cooling Plate Flow Velocity, Reynolds Number & Pressure Drop
lessons.summary: Calculate friction factor (Darcy-Weisbach) and convective heat transfer coefficient across mini-channel cold plates.
checkpoints: Ensure pressure drop remains below pump head capacity 35 kPa

lessons.title: Direct Immersion Dielectric Cooling vs. Bottom-Plate Benchmarking
lessons.summary: Comparative trade-off matrix: pumping power, heat rejection efficiency, thermal runaway barrier, and overall pack gravimetric density.
checkpoints: Demonstrate 60% reduction in cell-to-cell delta T with immersion
Quantify weight penalty vs thermal runway containment gain
